"""Save source-matched training, native geometry checks, and primary review."""
import ast
from collections import Counter
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path
import sys

from PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageFont
from safetensors import safe_open
import torch

BASE = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
REPO = BASE / "outputs/auto-wall"
WORK = BASE / "work/encounter-ml"
sys.path.insert(0, str(REPO))
from benchmarks.check_geometry import evaluate_geometry
from src.core.fast_pipeline import DetectionResult, to_uvtt
from src.ml.data import read_dataset
from src.ml.network import WINDOW_CLASSES


def read(path):
    return json.loads(Path(path).read_text(encoding="utf-8"))


def sha(path):
    return hashlib.sha256(Path(path).read_bytes()).hexdigest()


def artifact(path):
    path = Path(path)
    return {"path": str(path), "bytes": path.stat().st_size, "sha256": sha(path)}


def native_review(conclusions):
    rows = conclusions["native_review_rows"]
    width, row_height = 1250, 330
    canvas = Image.new("RGB", (width, 60 + row_height * len(rows)), "#151515")
    draw = ImageDraw.Draw(canvas)
    font = ImageFont.truetype("C:/Windows/Fonts/arial.ttf", 17)
    draw.text((10, 5), "v17 MODEL OUTPUT REVIEW - NOT TRAINING LABELS", font=font, fill="white")
    draw.text((10, 30), "Both panels show original source colors; inference appearance is stated per row.", font=font, fill="white")
    records = []
    for index, row in enumerate(rows):
        source = Path(f"C:/Users/Skyri/AppData/Local/FoundryVTT/Data/assets/maps/encounters/{row['site']}/source.png")
        box = row["crop"]
        original = Image.open(source).convert("RGB").crop(box)
        overlay = original.copy()
        path = BASE / "outputs/Encounter ML review" / row["folder"] / f"{row['site']}-detection.json"
        detection = read(path)
        local = ImageDraw.Draw(overlay)
        for key, color in (("walls", "lime"), ("doors", "magenta"),
                           ("windows", "yellow"), ("invisible_walls", "cyan")):
            for first, second in detection[key]:
                local.line([(first[0] - box[0], first[1] - box[1]),
                            (second[0] - box[0], second[1] - box[1])], fill=color, width=1)
        y = 60 + index * row_height
        draw.text((10, y), row["site"] + " / " + row["appearance"] + ": " + row["note"], font=font, fill="white")
        for x, content in ((10, original), (635, overlay)):
            enlarged = content.resize((content.width * 2, content.height * 2), Image.Resampling.NEAREST)
            assert enlarged.width <= 600 and enlarged.height <= row_height - 35
            canvas.paste(enlarged, (x, y + 30))
        records.append({**row, "source": artifact(source), "detection": artifact(path)})
    path = WORK / "v17-native-output-review.bmp"
    assert not path.exists()
    canvas.save(path)
    return {"image": artifact(path), "rows": records,
            "scope": "Selected native-coordinate diagnostics; originals shown on the left, exported model geometry on the right. Green walls, magenta doors, yellow windows, cyan movement-only segments. No labels are generated from this review."}


def main():
    baseline = read(REPO / "docs/ENCOUNTER_ML_BACKBONE_RESULTS.json")
    for sample in baseline["unchanged_inputs"]:
        for key in ("image", "mask"):
            assert sha(sample[key]["path"]) == sample[key]["sha256"]
    for model in baseline["unchanged_production_models"]:
        assert sha(model["path"]) == model["sha256"]
    manifest = WORK / "dataset-v17-whistling-rails/combined-manifest.json"
    samples = read_dataset(manifest, WINDOW_CLASSES)
    assert Counter(sample["split"] for sample in samples) == {"train": 78, "validation": 6}
    training = read(WORK / "trial-v17-whistling-rails/training.json")
    expected = {sample["id"]: sample for sample in training["data_hashes"]}
    prior = {sample["id"]: sample for sample in baseline["training"]["data_hashes"]}
    differences = []
    inputs = []
    for sample in samples:
        for key in ("pixels_sha256", "labels_sha256"):
            assert sample[key] == expected[sample["id"]][key]
        assert sample["pixels_sha256"] == prior[sample["id"]]["pixels_sha256"]
        if sample["labels_sha256"] != prior[sample["id"]]["labels_sha256"]:
            differences.append(sample["id"])
        inputs.append({"id": sample["id"], "group": sample["group"], "split": sample["split"],
                       "image": artifact(sample["image"]), "mask": artifact(sample["mask"])})
    assert differences == ["whistling-stones"]
    sources = {}
    for name, expected_hash in training["source_sha256"].items():
        path = REPO / name
        assert sha(path) == expected_hash, name
        sources[name] = {**artifact(path), "source": path.read_bytes().decode("utf-8")}
    torch.set_num_threads(4)
    checkpoints = []
    initialization = WORK / "trial-v2-precision/best.safetensors"
    for name in ("best", "last"):
        path = WORK / f"trial-v17-whistling-rails/{name}.safetensors"
        changed = Counter()
        with safe_open(initialization, framework="pt", device="cpu") as initial, safe_open(path, framework="pt", device="cpu") as current:
            assert initial.keys() == current.keys()
            for key in current.keys():
                tensor = current.get_tensor(key)
                assert torch.isfinite(tensor).all()
                if key.startswith("backbone.") and not torch.equal(tensor, initial.get_tensor(key)):
                    group = key.split(".")[3] if key.startswith("backbone.encoder.layer.") else "layernorm"
                    changed[group] += 1
            assert set(changed) == {"10", "11", "layernorm"}, dict(changed)
            details = json.loads(current.metadata()["details"])
        checkpoints.append({**artifact(path), "selected_step": details["selected_step"],
                            "changed_backbone_groups": dict(changed), "other_backbone_tensors_exact": True})
    evaluations = []
    by_id = {sample["id"]: sample for sample in samples}
    for path in sorted((BASE / "outputs/Encounter ML review").glob("v17-*/report.json")):
        report = read(path)
        records = []
        for sample in report["samples"]:
            assert sample["split"] != "test"
            detection_path = path.parent / f"{sample['id']}-detection.json"
            serialized = read(detection_path)
            assert serialized.pop("format") == "auto-wall-detection-v1"
            assert serialized.pop("coordinate_system") == "source_image_pixels"
            detection = DetectionResult(**serialized)
            record = {**sample, "detection_artifact": artifact(detection_path)}
            if "geometry_annotations" in by_id[sample["id"]]:
                record["legacy_geometry_checks"] = evaluate_geometry(
                    to_uvtt(detection, report["experiment"]["settings"]["grid_size"], preview=True),
                    by_id[sample["id"]]["geometry_annotations"])
            records.append(record)
        evaluations.append({"report": artifact(path), "model": report["model"],
                            "experiment": report["experiment"], "samples": records})
    assert len(evaluations) == 10 and sum(len(item["samples"]) for item in evaluations) == 36
    conclusions_path = WORK / "v17-primary-conclusions.json"
    conclusions = read(conclusions_path)
    assert conclusions["promoted"] is False
    assert conclusions["selection_scores"] == {
        "v16": max(row["selection_score"] for row in baseline["training"]["history"]),
        "v17": max(row["selection_score"] for row in training["history"]),
    }
    full_tests = WORK / "whistling-full-tests.log"
    oracle = WORK / "whistling-native-oracle-tests.log"
    lint = WORK / "whistling-ruff.log"
    assert "354 passed, 3 warnings" in full_tests.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    assert "1 passed" in oracle.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    assert "All checks passed!" in lint.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    scripts = {}
    for name in ("draft_whistling_rails_v1.py", "draft_whistling_rails_v2.py", "draft_whistling_rails.py",
                 "admit_whistling_rails.py", "prepare_whistling_extension.py", "run_v17_whistling.py",
                 "evaluate_v17_whistling.py", "record_whistling_trial.py"):
        path = WORK / name
        source = path.read_bytes().decode("utf-8")
        ast.parse(source)
        scripts[name] = {**artifact(path), "source": source}
    result = {
        "format": "auto-wall-rail-style-research-v1", "reference_head": "d8e6bdddd0a96059f29120ed357f6f2ec09dd2ad",
        "scope": "One source-reviewed training-only rope-rail extension, 2400-step two-block DINO trial and 36 native export cases. Partial source-assisted labels are not exhaustive independent human ground truth. No final-test map is read by preparation, training or evaluation. No production model promoted.",
        "training": training, "invocation": read(WORK / "trial-v17-invocation.json"),
        "manifest": artifact(manifest), "data_change_provenance": read(manifest)["whistling_rail_provenance"],
        "annotation_review": read(REPO / "benchmarks/data/encounters/additional-whistling-v1/review.json"),
        "changed_training_masks": differences, "inputs": inputs, "checkpoints": checkpoints,
        "training_source_snapshots": sources, "script_sources": scripts, "evaluations": evaluations,
        "primary_conclusions": {**artifact(conclusions_path), "content": conclusions},
        "native_review": native_review(conclusions),
        "unchanged_production_models": baseline["unchanged_production_models"],
        "validation": {"full_local": {**artifact(full_tests), "command": "python -B -m pytest tests -q", "passed": 354},
                       "native_annotation_oracle": {**artifact(oracle), "command": "python -B -m pytest tests/test_encounter_training.py::test_whistling_rail_cores_preserve_prior_labels_and_exclude_rejected_post_positions -q", "passed": 1},
                       "ruff": {**artifact(lint), "command": "python -B -m ruff check tests/test_encounter_training.py", "result": "All checks passed!"}},
    }
    out = REPO / "docs/ENCOUNTER_ML_RAIL_RESULTS.json"
    assert not out.exists()
    out.write_text(json.dumps(result, indent=2) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
    print(json.dumps({"result": str(out), "sha256": sha(out), "cases": 36, "changed_training_masks": differences}))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

content.decision: Retain the installed five-class semantic-light model. The added rail style produces a measured fence gain, but neither v17 checkpoint meets the combined door/window/fence precision and coverage requirements.
content.measured_gain: The v17 final step-2400 checkpoint passes the existing Rimebell fence-movement ray in both original and recolored validation appearances. The v16 selected and final checkpoints failed this ray in both appearances. Source-coordinate overlay review shows movement geometry following actual wooden railing in the examined area. This is one partial passage check, not proof of complete or precise fencing across the map.
content.selected_checkpoint: The unchanged partial-label precision selector chooses step 1200 with score 0.69799, versus v16's 0.67594. This metric does not establish native topology accuracy. Selected v17 still fails Rimebell's fence ray in both appearances.
validation_failures: Both v17 checkpoints match only two of three annotated Rimebell doors in both appearances, and the south-door ray fails. The prior v16 selected checkpoint matched all three on the original appearance.
Neither checkpoint matches the annotated Mothveil door or framed glass assembly in either appearance. The window-movement ray remains open.
Final recolored Mothveil exports one unmatched window across a masonry stair landing, not glass. Final original Mothveil also exports three movement-only segments on an interior timber support.

Antler and Cinderglass export zero walls, doors, windows and movement barriers in all four validation runs. This preserves those explicit structure-free checks; it does not establish precision on unreviewed regions elsewhere.
content.training_fit: The prior v16 selected checkpoint exports no Whistling fence and fails all three new rope movement checks in both appearances. Selected v17 exports 115/84 movement segments and final v17 exports 72/68 on original/recolored Whistling. Both v17 checkpoints pass the upper-rope movement check but still fail the lower-horizontal and lower-curved checks. All three sight and three reviewed-ground movement checks pass. Gullthorn's full-span guardrail movement check also still fails on selected v17 in both appearances. These training-fit cases are not held-out evidence.
content.experimental_limits: This trial adds one training map's partial labels and changes its crop sampling weight from 1 to 10. The checkpoint loader also skips random initialization since d8e6bdd, changing torch RNG consumption on load although loaded tensors are unchanged. No isolated causal claim is made for the label extension alone. Recolored appearances share layouts with originals and are not independent samples. No final-test inputs are read. The six-class segmentation candidate has no retained semantic-light center head and is not a deployable replacement for the selected application model.
content.next_requirement: Continue source-reviewed rail boundary/negative supervision and add independent physical-glass styles before broad accuracy claims. Evaluate native passage continuity and unmatched structure errors alongside partial pixel metrics; do not lower confidence or remove prop guards to conceal the remaining failures.
